Jerome offers flashes of brilliance, but Caswell's play lacks the narrative cohesion and polish needed to bind its provocative ideas fully.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this AIDS-era drama set in an Arizona ghost town, with some praising its moving portrayal of older gay men and strong performances, while others find it unfocused and dramatically inert despite its ambitions.
